name: Custodian stalker

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Allows Ancient Custodian to spawn after killing an Elder custodian stalker.

unlocks.name: Un-restraining Order
unlocks.notes: Number of custodian stalkers assigned is increased to 200-250.

variantInfo.name: Juvenile custodian stalker
notes: Requires 54 Slayer and attacks with crush plus a low-health bleed special.
Drops broken antlers but no antler guard or alchemist's signet.

variantInfo.name: Mature custodian stalker
notes: Requires 67 Slayer and can drop the antler guard and huasca seeds.
Uses crush, magic, and a low-health bleed special that Protect from Magic can block.

variantInfo.name: Elder custodian stalker
notes: Requires 76 Slayer, can drop alchemist's signet, and is the only variant that can spawn Ancient Custodian.
At 20% hitpoints it can apply a bleed special for 9 damage over 15 ticks unless blocked or missed.

variantInfo.name: Ancient Custodian
notes: Superior slayer monster variant unlocked by Bigger and Badder after killing an Elder custodian stalker.
Rolls three extra regular-table drops in addition to superior Slayer tertiary rewards.

locationComparison.name: Stalker Den
notes: The task page does not publish one combined spawn count for the family.
The Stalker Den has multicombat cannonable zones in the south-west and single-combat caverns in the south-east and north.
A safespot is documented for Elder custodian stalkers in the western single-combat area.

taskNotes: Custodian stalkers require 54 Slayer and completion of Shadows of Custodia; Chaeldar assigns 70-130 at weight 11 and Nieve assigns 110-170 at weight 8.
The Un-restraining Order extension costs 100 Slayer reward points and increases assignments to 200-250.
The Stalker Den is the sole task location; do not reuse stalker-den-zygomites, which is the Ancient Zygomite tuned copy.
The Stalker Den has multicombat cannonable zones in the south-west, and single-combat caverns in the south-east and north.
Most damage is prevented with Protect from Melee, but the low-health spore special can cause bleed and may be blocked with Protect from Magic.
Gear with high magic defence such as dragonhide reduces the chance of taking damage from the special attack.
Players are encouraged to reach 76 Slayer for Elder custodian stalkers, which have better drops and are the only variant that can spawn Ancient Custodian.
Ranged multicombat with a dwarf multicannon and Venator bow is the first wiki equipment tab; magic multicombat and melee single-combat are alternatives.

slayerTargetId 244 is a synthetic placeholder per the WC-1..11 contract (240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value for Custodian stalker is unverified and detection falls back to the RuneLite task-name path.
recommendedMethod: Use the Stalker Den's south-west multicombat cannonable area with ranged gear such as Venator bow, Protect from Melee, and prayer restoration; switch to magic multicombat or melee in single-combat caverns as preferred, and prioritise Elder custodian stalkers at 76 Slayer for superior spawns and better drops.
